source.title: Asian Championship 2014 on November 1-3, 2014 in Matsudo, Chiba, Japan
source.content: The [Asian Championship 2014](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2014) will take place on November 1-3, 2014 in Matsudo, Chiba, Japan. Check out the [Asian Championship 2014 website](http://jrca.cc/ac2014/) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2014 年亚洲锦标赛将于 11 月 1 至 3 日在日本千叶县松户市举行
translation.content: [2014 年亚洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2014)将于 2014 年 11 月 1 至 3 日在日本千叶县松户市举行。更多信息及报名，请查看[2014 年亚洲锦标赛网站](http://jrca.cc/ac2014/)。
